title: Customer Service Rep (Remote)
description:
Elite Virtual Assistance (EVA) is expanding our support team for a rapidly growing network of Men’s Health Clinics across the United States. These clinics focus on helping men improve their health and confidence through services such as testosterone optimization, weight-loss programs (including medications like Ozempic), and overall wellness coaching.


We are seeking a high-caliber Customer Service Representative with exceptional English fluency, strong professionalism, and the ability to manage a diverse set of responsibilities. This is a remote role based in Brazil.


Key Responsibilities


1. Customer Service & Appointment Coordination
  • Answer inbound calls with empathy, clarity, and professionalism.
  • Set appointments for new potential customers (warm and high-intent leads).
  • Handle outbound follow-ups to support patient engagement and retention.
  • Provide accurate information on clinic services and guide callers through next steps.


2. Client Care & Wellness Follow-Up
  • Call patients who recently visited the clinic to check in, support them, and document their progress.
  • Help ensure clients stay on track with programs such as testosterone therapy or weight-loss plans.
  • Capture detailed notes and updates in the CRM to support continuity of care.


3. Administrative & Executive Assistant Support

Some clinic owners manage multiple businesses. At times, you will assist with:

  • General administrative tasks
  • Appointment booking and calendar management
  • Email organization and coordination
  • Light executive assistant duties outside the clinic scope


4. Content Support (As Requested by Individual Clinics)
  • Assist with simple social media content creation and posting
  • Support brand engagement and community-building initiatives


Required Qualifications
  • Exceptional English — written and spoken; near-native fluency required
  • Strong customer service orientation with a calm, confident phone presence
  • Ability to multitask while maintaining accuracy and detail
  • Professionalism, reliability, and strong time-management skills
  • Experience in healthcare, wellness, sales support, or customer service is a plus
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment supporting multiple stakeholders
  • Tech-savvy with the ability to learn new systems quickly (CRM, phone platforms, etc.)


Schedule & Work Environment
  • Standard schedule for this account is Wednesday–Sunday, 11:00 AM–7:00 PM (clinic’s local time) .
  • Some clinics operate Monday–Friday ; flexibility is a strong advantage.
  • Fully remote in Brazil , with stable internet required.


Compensation
  • $800–$1,000 USD/month (based on experience)
  • Performance incentives tied to quality, professionalism, and appointment outcomes
  • Opportunities for internal advancement within EVA as accounts grow


About EVA

Elite Virtual Assistance (EVA) provides high-quality remote staffing solutions for U.S.-based companies. We pride ourselves on delivering exceptional service, strong operational structure, and top-tier talent from around the world. You will join a supportive, high-performance team with clear pathways for growth.

If you are driven, articulate, and excited to support a mission-driven wellness organization, we would love to meet you.

Apply now and help transform the customer experience for men striving to improve their health and confidence.

title: Tech Lead Hands-on (Microsoft Stack)
description:
Tech Lead Hands-on (Microsoft Stack)


Sobre a vaga:


Estamos em busca de um(a) Tech Lead Hands-on com sólida bagagem técnica e experiência no ecossistema Microsoft, para liderar o desenvolvimento de soluções de IA, automação e produtividade em um ambiente colaborativo e inovador.


Essa posição combina liderança técnica e atuação prática em código , com foco em prototipar MVPs , garantir boas práticas de engenharia e impulsionar o uso de tecnologias Microsoft como Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, SharePoint e Databricks .


A atuação é 100% remota , mas seria um diferencial profissionais com disponibilidade para encontros presenciais em Guarulhos – SP, uma vez por semana .

Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar tecnicamente times multidisciplinares no desenho e execução de soluções em nuvem e IA.
  • Atuar de forma hands-on , participando ativamente de análises, codificação e revisão de código.
  • Prototipar e desenvolver MVPs (Minimum Viable Products) para validação e aceleração de entregas.
  • Utilizar a Microsoft Suite completa (Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Power Apps, Power Automate, SharePoint) na criação de soluções integradas.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de dados e negócio para identificar oportunidades de automação e eficiência.
  • Garantir qualidade técnica, segurança, performance e escalabilidade das soluções construídas.

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência comprovada como Tech Lead , Engenheiro(a) de Software ou Arquiteto(a) de Soluções , com atuação prática em desenvolvimento.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Azure Cloud (preferencialmente AI e Data Services).
  • Experiência com Azure AI Foundry e Copilot Studio .
  • Domínio em Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, SharePoint).
  • Vivência com Databricks e integração de dados e APIs.
  • Capacidade de construir e evoluir provas de conceito e MVPs funcionais .
  • Forte base em engenharia de software (versionamento, testes, pipelines de CI/CD, boas práticas).

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com IA generativa e copilots personalizados .
  • Vivência com MLOps , DataOps ou automação inteligente.
  • Experiência em Projetos corporativos de transformação digital .
  • Inglês técnico para leitura, documentação e acompanhamento de roadmaps de produto.
  • Disponibilidade para presença semanal em Guarulhos – SP .

Perfil esperado:

  • Profissional com visão sistêmica e perfil de liderança técnica , capaz de unir estratégia e execução.
  • Autonomia e proatividade para atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e em evolução constante.
  • Paixão por tecnologia Microsoft e inovação com IA.
  • Boa comunicação, colaboração e clareza ao traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas.

title: Regional Manager
description:
Regional Manager – Latin America (Full-Time, Commission-Based)

Doktar Technologies | Latin America (Remote)

AgriTech • Sustainability • IoT Solutions


About Doktar Technologies B.V.

Headquartered in the Netherlands and operating globally, Doktar develops data-driven technologies that enable climate-smart and sustainable agriculture. Through our IoT devices, digital platforms, and Climate & Sustainability Impact programs, we support farmers, multinational corporations, and governments in building more resilient, traceable, and regenerative agri-food value chains.


The Opportunity

We are expanding our footprint across Latin America and are seeking a Regional Manager to lead our commercial growth and strategic partnerships in the region.

This is a full-time, freelance, commission-only collaboration , designed for entrepreneurial professionals ready to build and scale a market.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead business development and partnership activities across Latin America
  • Develop and manage sustainability and regenerative agriculture programs with agri-food corporations
  • Represent Doktar’s full portfolio: IoT devices, digital platforms, and sustainability programs
  • Build strong relationships with multinational F&B companies, exporters, cooperatives, and large producers
  • Coordinate local project execution and client reporting
  • Collaborate closely with Doktar’s international Business Development and Sustainability teams
  • Develop and execute regional growth strategy, with priority focus on Northern LATAM and South America markets


Collaboration Model

  • Full-time freelance agreement
  • High, performance-based commission structure (no fixed base salary)
  • Attractive earning potential directly linked to revenue generation
  • Long-term partnership opportunity for high performers


Who You Are

  • Experienced in agriculture, sustainability, ESG, or agri-food sectors
  • Proven track record in corporate sales, partnerships, or project development
  • Strong network within multinational agri-food or FMCG companies
  • Previous experience in large Latin American markets such as Mexico & Brazil is considered a strong plus
  • Fluent in English, Spanish & Portuguese
  • Entrepreneurial, independent, and commercially driven


Join Us

If you are passionate about sustainability and ready to scale a high-impact AgriTech business in Latin America, we would love to connect.

title: Senior C/C++ engineer with Python
description:
Project Description:

Founded in 1984, our client is one of the world's leading provider of lithography systems for the semiconductor industry, manufacturing complex machines that are critical to the production of integrated circuits or chips. The client has its R&D and manufacturing operations in The Netherlands.

Luxoft is currently searching to augment the Development & Engineering Department with a talented software engineer to design and implement embedded software for systems among the highest precision ever produced in the world.


Responsibilities:

  • As a software engineer, you will be working on Linux server applications for metrology components and on complex algorithms application software. You will be working with electrical engineers, mechatronic engineers and system engineers to define the software requirements.
  • A team of about 10 people consisting of a team lead, a sw architect, a few senior developers. After your SW design is approved you are responsible for implementing the design in Python & C for new modules.
  • During testing, you will collect the necessary data so you can write a test report.
  • The development environment is Red Hat Linux, execution environment is Wind River Linux. The software release driving a client machine is 40 million lines of code. Client SW teams work in various modes such as Agile and SAFE.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • We are looking for colleagues with at least 5 years of development experience.
  • Python: application coding
  • Linux (one of more of the following): familiar with command line tools, makefile, git, shell and python scripting
  • Embedded C and C++: understanding and maintaining legacy code. Adding new features while keeping compliance with established architecture.
  • Version control using command line is also required - Git, Clear Case and SVN, in this order of priority.


Languages:

  • English: C1 Advanced

title: Pricing Operations Manager/Production Manager
description:
Please send me resume in English format only


Remote role

Target start date: March

Time zone: CST


Role Overview:

The team is looking for someone with an operations background who can support the Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams.

This role will focus heavily on metrics, reporting, and sales process improvement. The team is currently working on building reports in Power BI and needs someone who is highly data-oriented and understands business context—not just a report builder.


The ideal candidate should be able to:

Help build and refine metrics and reporting

Analyze data and provide meaningful insights

Identify areas of concern and highlight issues

Redefine and improve existing reports and analysis

Extract data, work with Excel, and be hands-on with data

Not necessarily a Power BI expert or data engineer, but comfortable working with data directly


Ideal Candidate Profile:

Minimum 5 years of experience

Strong understanding of workflows, processes, and flowcharts

Ability to work closely with business teams

Salesforce.com experience is highly preferred

Experience measuring sales team performance and understanding where data resides

Ability to assess process metrics and behavioral metrics (e.g., ensuring accurate data entry across sales organizations)

Capable of telling a clear story through data and explaining discrepancies in current reporting

Bachelor’s degree is a plus

Experience in companies like VMware would be beneficial

title: Endpoint Engineer
description:
**Fully Remote 6-month contract**


Qualifications

Required Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 3–8 years of enterprise endpoint engineering and administration experience.
  • Enterprise endpoint management using Microsoft Intune, MECM/SCCM , and co-managed environments.
  • Strong experience with Windows 10/11 , Active Directory/GPO, and endpoint security tooling (e.g., CrowdStrike).
  • Experience with Azure VDI services; third-party VDI platforms (e.g., Workspot) preferred.
  • Endpoint hardware experience across HP, Lenovo, Dell, and Apple platforms.
  • Application packaging and deployment for enterprise endpoints; experience with Office 365, Adobe products, browsers, and remote access tools.


Plusses

  • macOS endpoint management experience (Intune, JAMF, Kandji, or similar) preferred.
  • Scripting and automation experience using PowerShell ; Power Automate a plus.
  • Experience with SQL querying and reporting; Power BI experience a plus.
  • Familiarity with pharmaceutical or laboratory applications is a plus.
  • Exposure to AI productivity tools (e.g., Copilot, Copilot Studio) for proof-of-concept or assessment work is a plus.


Job Summary

This role is responsible for the design, engineering, administration, and advanced support of enterprise physical and virtual endpoint environments. The position owns endpoint platform management, device provisioning, application and OS deployment, security hardening, and L3 escalation support using modern endpoint management tools such as Microsoft Intune and MECM . The role also requires server and cloud-side administration to support endpoint management platforms, monitoring, and associated infrastructure services.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, engineer, and support enterprise desktop, laptop, and VDI provisioning services across corporate and laboratory environments using Intune, MECM, and related tools.
  • Administer and support endpoint management infrastructure, including virtual/physical servers and SaaS/PaaS/DaaS platforms, with responsibility for troubleshooting and recovery.
  • Manage endpoint OS, application, security, and feature update packaging and deployment; coordinate with managed service partners as needed.
  • Implement and maintain monitoring, alerting, and reporting solutions for endpoint platforms.
  • Provide Level 3 escalation support for endpoint technologies and supporting management platforms.
  • Apply ITIL v3 practices, SDLC standards, and change/service management processes, including documentation, change control, and incident/problem management.
  • Collaborate with End User Services, Security, and Infrastructure/Cloud teams to align endpoint services with enterprise strategies.
  • Advise business stakeholders on endpoint engineering capabilities, service offerings, and technical feasibility.
  • Contribute to service design, testing, lifecycle management, compliance documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Provide peer coverage and knowledge sharing as needed.

title: META & GOOGLE ADS MEDIA BUYER WITH FUNNEL EXPERIENCE
description:
HIRING PERFORMANCE MARKETER / MEDIA BUYER – $700–$1,200/MONTH


We’re a founder-led U.S. digital marketing & software agency and we’re looking for a killer Performance Marketer / Media Buyer to help us scale client results and funnels to the next level.

This is NOT a role for someone who just “turns ads on.”

We’re looking for someone who understands WHY ads work, how to build high-conversion direct-response funnels, and how to connect ads → funnels → revenue, Sabri Suby–style.


If you’re obsessed with performance, psychology, funnels, and results — keep reading.


Derby Digital is a small but fast-growing U.S.-based agency working directly with restaurants and service businesses across the U.S. We specialize in:

  • Performance marketing (Meta & Google Ads)
  • Direct-response funnels
  • WordPress & GoHighLevel systems
  • Growth-focused execution (not fluff)

This role works directly with the founder, meaning high ownership, fast decisions, and massive growth opportunity.

We are targeting the Philippines because we’ve had exceptional success working with Filipino talent — hardworking, detail-oriented, and hungry to grow.

About the Role

You will be our Performance Marketer / Media Buyer , responsible for:

title: Desenvolvedor trainee
description:
Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Pleno para atuar na evolução do nosso produto no Tiino.

Valorizamos qualidade, simplicidade e responsabilidade técnica. Nosso foco é construir soluções bem estruturadas, sustentáveis e evolutivas — mais importante que velocidade é fazer bem feito.

A pessoa atuará com .NET 10 (C#) no backend e React com MUI no frontend, contribuindo tecnicamente nas decisões e na melhoria contínua do sistema.


Modelo de trabalho: Presencial / Hibrido – Joinville/SC

Contratação: Cooperativa


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver e manter APIs em .NET 10 (C#)
  • Desenvolver interfaces utilizando React + MUI
  • Implementar novas funcionalidades e corrigir bugs
  • Participar de decisões técnicas
  • Realizar code reviews
  • Evoluir código existente com foco em qualidade e performance
  • Dividir entregas em partes menores e bem estruturadas
  • Contribuir com melhorias técnicas contínuas


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento Web
  • Experiência sólida com C# e .NET
  • Experiência prática com React
  • Experiência na construção de APIs REST
  • Conhecimento em PostgreSQL ou banco relacional
  • Experiência com Git
  • Boa base em orientação a objetos e Clean Code
  • Capacidade de atuar com autonomia
  • Interesse em aprendizado contínuo


Diferenciais

  • Entity Framework Core / LINQ
  • Testes automatizados
  • Docker
  • CI/CD

title: Senior-Principal .NET Engineer
description:
Project Description:

Small team of expert level engineers to deliver changes across multiple services related to arbitrage.


Primary Stack: .NET, Kafka, MSSQL, Azure


Responsibilities:

- Collaborate with Portfolio managers and external teams

- Derive requirements and match it with architecture solutions

- Develop, test and deploy applications

- L3 support of end users and business


Mandatory Skills Description:

• Independent mindset, passion for technology, and an appetite for taking ownership, learning new technologies, and building innovative products.

• Minimum 5 years of development experience in financial services or technology industries.

• Full lifecycle experience including requirements gathering, implementation, testing, release, and support.

• Strong technical and development skills in cross-platform environment, preferably in C#

• Experience in Cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP) experience involving stateless and serverless solutions, event-driven architecture and cost optimization

• Experience in IaC development with Terraform/OpenTofu/Bicep/Pulumi

• Experience in container technologies (e.g., Docker, Podman) and container orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker Swarm).

• Experience with SQL development, preferably in a SQL Server environment.

• Exposure to multi-threaded programming concepts.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Strong team player.

• Bachelor's degree in computer science or engineering.

• .NET Core and Entity Framework Core.


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

• Knowledge of arbitrage strategies

• Experience with various financial products such as equities, derivatives, fixed income, etc., and related terminology.

• Experience working with market data (e.g. Bloomberg APIs, etc.).

• Experience with containerization and orchestrators.

• Experience with Test Driven Development.

• Experience with profiling and performance tuning techniques throughout the entire stack.

• Experience with NoSQL databases, including document databases and graph databases.

• Angular experience.


Languages:

English: C1 Advanced

title: Omnistudio Developer
description:
Salesforce Developer – OmniStudio & Communications Cloud


The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and delivering scalable and high‑quality Salesforce solutions within a digital transformation project in the telecommunications industry. You will work with OmniStudio, Salesforce Communications Cloud, and core Salesforce technologies to build optimized business processes. You will test your code, ensure quality through best practices, and collaborate in Agile environments.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement scalable solutions using OmniStudio (OmniScripts, FlexCards, DataRaptors, Integration Procedures).
  • Build and configure applications within Salesforce Communications Cloud (formerly Vlocity CPQ/EPC).
  • Participate in the development of telecom business processes such as quote‑to‑order , customer onboarding , and service provisioning .
  • Write clear, maintainable, and high‑quality code using Apex , LWC , and Salesforce configuration tools.
  • Support integration development using REST, SOAP, JSON, XML .
  • Collaborate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, estimation, and reviews.
  • Perform unit testing and provide support throughout SIT and UAT cycles.
  • Document technical specifications, solution designs, and deployment guidelines.
  • Contribute to CI/CD workflows using tools such as Copado, Git, Jenkins, Ant .


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands‑on experience with Salesforce development .
  • 2+ years of experience with OmniStudio development.
  • Strong experience with:
  • OmniScripts, FlexCards, DataRaptors, Integration Procedures
  • Salesforce configuration, Apex , and LWC
  • Salesforce Communications Cloud (Vlocity CPQ & EPC)
  • Experience integrating systems using REST/SOAP APIs and working with JSON/XML formats.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Copado, Git, Jenkins, Ant).
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments (SAFe Agile preferred).
  • Strong debugging, analytical, and troubleshooting skills.


Preferred Certifications

  • Salesforce Platform Developer I
  • OmniStudio Developer Certification
  • Salesforce Industries CPQ Developer (nice to have)

title: Salesforce QA Manual
description:
QA Manual Tester – Salesforce

The ideal candidate will be responsible for validating the quality, functionality, and user experience of Salesforce-based applications. You will design and execute manual test cases, analyze requirements, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure high‑quality product delivery. You will identify defects, support regression cycles, and participate actively in Agile ceremonies.


Responsibilities

  • Analyze business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria to ensure full test coverage.
  • Design, execute, and document manual functional test cases.
  • Validate application behavior across various environments (Dev, QA, UAT ).
  • Perform cross‑browser testing and verify UI alignment with design and UX specifications.
  • Log defects with clear reproduction steps and work closely with developers to ensure timely resolution.
  • Maintain and update regression test suites to support continuous delivery.
  • Participate actively in Agile/Scrum ceremonies (daily standups, sprint reviews, retrospectives).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and contribute to continuous process improvement.


Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience working with Salesforce in a QA or functional testing role.
  • Strong understanding of CRM concepts beyond end-user functionality.
  • Semi‑Senior to Senior experience in manual software testing .
  • Knowledge and hands-on experience with Agile Scrum methodology .
  • Experience working with Jira and Azure DevOps for test management and defect tracking.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work in collaborative environments.
  • Proactive mindset, ownership, and strong attention to detail.


Preferred Certifications (Not mandatory)

  • Salesforce Administrator
  • Salesforce App Builder
  • Salesforce Associate

title: SDR / Appointment Setter (Remoto)
description:
Vaga: SDR / Appointment Setter (Remoto – Mercado Reino Unido)

Estamos à procura de um(a) SDR / Appointment Setter para atuar remotamente com leads qualificados no mercado do Reino Unido (clínicas premium).

Não é cold call puro.

As pessoas já demonstraram interesse — o trabalho é ligar, qualificar e agendar a consulta.

Responsabilidades
  • Ligar para leads que solicitaram informação
  • Fazer follow-up com leads que não atenderam
  • Qualificar interesse e perfil
  • Agendar consultas no calendário da clínica
  • Atualizar CRM com notas detalhadas
  • Seguir script e processo estruturado
  • Reportar métricas semanalmente
Requisitos
  • Inglês avançado/fluente (ligações serão 100% em inglês)
  • Boa dicção e clareza ao telefone
  • Perfil comunicativo e confiante
  • Organização e disciplina
  • Internet estável e ambiente silencioso
  • Experiência com vendas ou atendimento é diferencial
Remuneração
  • R$1.000 – R$1.200 fixo (part-time)
  • Bonus por consulta que comparecer (show-up)
  • Possibilidade real de aumento conforme performance

Carga horária estimada:

4 horas por dia (segunda a sexta)

Métricas Avaliadas
  • Taxa de contacto (% de leads atendidos)
  • Taxa de agendamento
  • Taxa de comparecimento
  • Tempo médio de resposta ao lead

Performance importa.

Oportunidade

Trabalhar com mercado internacional (UK).

Possibilidade de crescimento conforme aumento de volume e resultados.

Para se candidatar:

Enviar mensagem com:

  • Experiência anterior
  • Disponibilidade de horário
  • Um áudio de 1 minuto simulando uma ligação em inglês para um lead interessado no nicho de Clinicas
  • Nível de inglês (autoavaliação)

title: BackEnd Developer - Java Spring
description:
Sobre a YellowIpe


Nossa missão é inspirar a conexão entre tecnologia e pessoas, fomentando o melhor de nossos profissionais por meio de nossa expertise em encontrar e atrair os melhores talentos para os melhores projetos. O foco nas Pessoas, Colaboração e Comprometimento são os pilares que nos guiam nessa trajetória.

Junte-se à nossa equipe como nosso novo Desenvolvedor Backend Java/Spring!


Integração numa equipe dedicada à constução de um produto third-party de longo prazo, com foco em escalabilidade, performance e arquitetura cloud-native.


Responsabilidades:


  • Desenvolvimento de APIs REST com Java e Spring Boot
  • Implementação de novas features e manutenção evolutiva
  • Integração com bases de dados SQL e NoSQL
  • Escrita de código limpo, testável e escalável
  • Participação em code reviews
  • Colaboração com equipas de frontend, QA e DevOps
  • Contribuição para decisões técnicas e melhoria contínua


Requisitos:

  • +5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento Java
  • Experiência sólida com Spring / Spring Boot
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de APIs REST
  • Experiência com bases de dados relacionais (ex: PostgreSQL, MySQL)
  • Experiência com bases de dados NoSQL (ex: MongoDB)
  • Experiência com Docker
  • Conhecimentos de Kubernetes
  • Experiência em ambientes Agile


Informação importante:

  • Modelo de trabalho remoto.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
PLEASE READ THE JOB DESCRIPTION BEFORE APPLYING


Metrobi is a VC-backed startup and an alumni of Techstars Boston, one of the leading accelerators in the USA.


We power deliveries for local food and beverage businesses in Boston, New York, DC, Chicago, LA, and other major metropolitan areas. Our technology is at the center of our delivery marketplace.


Intro video:


Why should you join Metrobi?

  • Play a key role in shaping performance marketing strategy.
  • Fast-paced, growth-oriented environment with plenty of room to test & learn.
  • Opportunity to directly impact conversions and revenue.
  • International team experience and a supportive work environment.
  • A well-funded company that offers competitive compensation.
  • An opportunity to learn every day in a fast-paced environment.
  • A chance to become a part of a dynamic company on a fast track to change the logistics scene in the US.


About the role

We’re looking for a data-driven Digital Marketing Specialist who loves experimenting, optimizing, and scaling growth. If you enjoy working with WordPress and creating compelling content for emails and landing pages, this role is for you.


  • Professional English Proficiency is a must.
  • Hiring interviews will be conducted online.


What you’ll do:

  • Build and iterate on landing pages (WordPress + Elementor), testing buttons, hero texts, CTAs, and layouts.
  • Run A/B tests & experiments to improve conversion rates continuously.
  • Track, analyze, and report performance.
  • Understand the audience and work on improving the copy from email marketing campaigns.


(Musts)

We’re looking for someone that has hands-on experience with:

  • WordPress & Elementor.
  • SEO
  • Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) and A/B testing.
  • Creating content for email marketing campaigns
  • Landing page creation


This role is not for you if:

  • You have only worked with Ads and paid media before.
  • You have only worked for marketing agencies before
  • You don't have any experience with generating leads and measuring the results .


Nice to have:

  • Basic HTML/CSS
  • Understanding of UI/UX principles for better user journeys.
  • Experience with Google Ads / Meta Ads / LinkedIn Ads
  • Familiarity with Google Sheets


  • This is a remote position.
  • Must be able to work between (9AM-6PM EST)

title: Crypto Community Partner
description:
CryptoHubDubai is expanding into Latin America and looking for well-connected crypto enthusiasts in Brazil to join as Crypto Community Partner.

We provide institutional-grade ASIC miners and secure hosting infrastructure in Dubai. Many crypto investors are looking for alternative ways to deploy capital beyond trading. Your role will be to connect interested investors with our infrastructure solutions.

This is a relationship-focused opportunity. No technical background required. If you are active in crypto groups, Telegram communities, events or investor circles, you can turn your network into a strong revenue stream.

Key Responsibilities

• Connect private crypto investors with mining and hosting opportunities

• Engage with Brazilian crypto communities and online groups

• Introduce qualified prospects to the internal advisory team

• Maintain long-term relationships with referred investors

• Represent the company at local crypto events and meetups

Requirements

• Active in Brazilian crypto communities

• Strong personal network in digital assets or investment circles

• Basic understanding of Bitcoin and crypto fundamentals

• Portuguese native level, English conversational

• Entrepreneurial mindset

Compensation

Base Salary: USD 100,000 – 160,000 per year

Token Allocation: Performance-based allocation linked to capital introduced

Legacy: Commission on investor capital with uncapped upside

title: LATAM Laywer
description:
Eudia is revolutionising legal work through AI-powered Augmented Intelligence, empowering Fortune 500 legal teams to accelerate decision-making, mitigate risk, and drive strategic growth. With $105M in Series A funding led by General Catalyst, we’re crafting a category-defining platform that fuses AI-driven automation with human expertise, transforming legal departments into engines of innovation.


At Eudia, we move fast. Unlike traditional enterprise software, our teams ship solutions in days, not months—delivering real impact for some of the world’s largest companies. We’re solving one of the most complex, unsolved challenges in AI: bringing trust, accuracy, and security to legal automation. We’re passionate about reshaping the legal industry. If you’re looking for a place where you’ll be challenged, take ownership from day one, and work alongside some of the brightest minds in AI and legal —we’d love to tell you more.


Contract Attorney – LATAM Procurement (Portuguese & English Speaking)

Remote | LATAM | Full-time | 12-Month Contract


Eudia is partnering with a global, market-leading organization in the agribusiness and commodities sector to support its LATAM legal operations. We are seeking a mid-level Contract Attorney with strong procurement experience to join a high-volume, fast-paced contracts team on a 12-month fixed-term contract .


This role focuses on procurement and transportation-related agreements , supporting business stakeholders across LATAM. The successful candidate will work primarily in Portuguese, with the ability to communicate confidently in English in a regional and global environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Contract triage and intake
  • Review, redline, and negotiate procurement contracts (standard templates and third-party paper)
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external counterparties
  • Prepare clear summary comments on negotiated terms
  • Populate and maintain contract templates
  • Manage contract intake and workflows using Onit or similar contract management systems


Scope of Work

  • ~58% Procurement Contract Templates (CPT – no master agreement)
  • ~16% CPT Master Agreements
  • ~26% General Procurement Agreements
  • (All agreements fall within procurement, including transportation-related contracts.)


Requirements

  • Qualified lawyer in Brazil , with a Brazilian law license and legal training completed in Brazil
  • Mid-level legal experience in procurement, commercial, or contracts-focused roles
  • Fluency in Portuguese (written and spoken); all contracts and negotiations are conducted in Portuguese
  • Professional working proficiency in English
  • Strong knowledge of local procurement workflows in Brazil/LATAM
  • Experience reviewing and negotiating procurement or commercial agreements
  • Familiarity with contract lifecycle management tools (Onit experience preferred)


Additional Information

  • 12-month contract
  • Full-time position
  • LATAM-focused role aligned to Brazil time zone
  • Detailed workflows and processes will be provided during onboarding


If you’re a mid-level procurement-focused contract attorney looking to work with a globally recognized business through Eudia, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Senior React Native Developer
description:
Salary Open to negotitate based on experience, Competitive! (payment in USD)

(Full time position, independent contractor.)


StaffingAbroad is seeking a highly skilled Frontend Developer to join one of the #1 Fintech & Crypto companies in the United States . This is a unique opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and build world-class applications in a dynamic, innovative environment.

This position is offered as a 100% remote role.


About the Role

As a Frontend Developer, your primary skillset will be React Native , with additional strong experience in React being highly desirable. You’ll play a critical role in designing and delivering highly polished, pixel-perfect applications that provide exceptional user experiences. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and backend developers, to bring complex financial and crypto-related solutions to life.


What You’ll Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software design, or related field of study, or equivalent experience.
  • 6+ years' experience building production-grade web or mobile applications with a strong focus on UI excellence.
  • English C1 (MUST)
  • Deep expertise with React Native (primary skill).
  • Strong experience with React (highly desirable), including hooks, context, and performance optimization.
  • Strong TypeScript experience.
  • Expert-level CSS skills with proficiency in Tailwind and styled-components .
  • Proven track record of delivering pixel-perfect, highly polished user interfaces .
  • Experience building and maintaining reusable component libraries .
  • Experience with complex form implementations and client-state management .
  • Solid foundation in software development best practices.
  • Familiarity with software quality practices such as unit testing, mocking, integration testing, and code coverage.
  • Experience using source control (Git) .
  • Familiarity with Agile and Scrum methodologies .
  • Bilingual English (conversational level required) .
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Enthusiasm for working in a fast-paced, innovative environment and alignment with company culture and values.

Plus

  • Familiarity with Continuous Integration (CI/CD) pipelines (TeamCity, Azure DevOps).


Why Join?

  • 100% Remote –
  • Join a team that is shaping the future of #1 Fintech and Crypto in the U.S.

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
Join a team that values you. At StaffRight, we connect talented professionals with global opportunities—and we’re growing fast! With competitive pay, health insurance, paid time off (including national holidays), and a supportive HR team always in your corner, you’ll love building your career with us.


The Supply Chain Manager is responsible for managing end-to-end import operations, high-priority customer orders, and internal operational processes to ensure smooth, accurate, and reliable business performance. This role plays a critical part in maintaining customer satisfaction, financial accuracy, and operational efficiency, particularly within a food import and supply-chain environment. The Supply Chain Manager will also provide operational and administrative support to the CEO as required.


This role is open to all candidates in the Philippines and all over Latin America. For Latin American candidates, kindly submit an English Version of your CV.


What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Manage end-to-end supply chain operations, including import coordination, supplier communication, freight forwarding, and customs documentation
  • Oversee high-priority customer orders to ensure on-time, in-full (OTIF) delivery and 100% customer satisfaction
  • Proactively identify and resolve operational issues, delays, and discrepancies before they impact customers or costs
  • Maintain accurate records in NetSuite for orders, inventory, shipments, and vendor bills
  • Track and reconcile import costs, freight charges, duties, and multi-currency transactions with high financial accuracy
  • Create, maintain, and continuously improve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) within areas of responsibility
  • Build and maintain Excel-based trackers, reconciliations, and operational reports
  • Collaborate professionally with suppliers, freight partners, customers, and internal teams
  • Provide timely operational and administrative support to the CEO, including reporting, data analysis, and follow-ups on key action items


What We’re Looking For:

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • At least 2 years of experience managing import processes, ideally within the food industry
  • Proficiency in NetSuite or a similar ERP system
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (e.g., VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, formulas)
  • Available to work in US time zones (Graveyard shift in the Philippines)
  • Available to start within 2 weeks from job offer


Technical Requirements:

  • Comfortable in using time-trackers (e.g. Time Doctor)
  • Own laptop/desktop, noise-cancelling headphones, and webcam
  • Reliable internet connection (at least 50 Mbps)
  • Available backup equipment in cases of power and internet outages
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and Google Workspace
  • Proficiency in NetSuite or a similar ERP system
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (e.g., VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, formulas)


Why You’ll Love Working Here:

Competitive Compensation

We offer a monthly salary starting at USD 800 - 1,000 , with flexibility for higher compensation based on your experience and qualifications. This is a full-time role requiring a 40-hour work week, and we make sure your expertise is valued and your contributions are fairly rewarded.


✈️ Paid Time Off and Sick Leave:

We believe in work-life balance. Enjoy generous paid time off and sick leave policies, allowing you to recharge, travel, or rest when needed—all while knowing your role is secure.

title: Consultor financeiro
description:
Consultor Financeiro


Vitória, Espírito Santo, Brasil (Presencial)

Agro Não Para Brasil

Tipo de contratação: A combinar

Área: Comercial | Mercado Financeiro | Agronegócio




Sobre a empresa


A Agro Não Para Brasil é uma organização especializada na estruturação e captação de recursos financeiros para aquisição de propriedades rurais em todo o território nacional.


Atuamos conectando investidores e produtores a oportunidades estratégicas no agronegócio brasileiro, com foco em crescimento patrimonial, planejamento financeiro e expansão sustentável.


Com a expansão da operação no Espírito Santo, buscamos profissionais para integrar nossa equipe comercial em Vitória.




Responsabilidades


* Realizar prospecção ativa e qualificada de clientes potenciais;

* Conduzir reuniões comerciais consultivas;

* Apresentar soluções financeiras estruturadas para aquisição de propriedades rurais;

* Desenvolver relacionamento estratégico com investidores e produtores;

* Gerenciar pipeline comercial e acompanhar oportunidades até o fechamento;

* Contribuir diretamente para o crescimento da operação regional.




Requisitos


* Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;

* Perfil proativo e orientado a resultados;

* Organização e disciplina profissional;

* Comprometimento com metas;

* Interesse em atuar nos setores financeiro e do agronegócio.


Não exigimos experiência prévia. Valorizamos dedicação, postura profissional e ambição de crescimento.




Diferenciais


* Experiência nas áreas comercial, financeira ou agronegócio;

* Vivência com prospecção ativa e negociação;

* Perfil estratégico e analítico;

* Networking empresarial ou rural.




O que oferecemos


* Plano de desenvolvimento profissional;

* Remuneração compatível com o mercado (fixo + variável por desempenho);

* Ambiente orientado à performance;

* Oportunidade de crescimento interno;

* Participação em um projeto de impacto nacional no agronegócio.




Interessados podem se candidatar diretamente pela plataforma ou enviar currículo para avaliação.

title: Remote Biomedical Informatics SME - 58854
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are seeking highly skilled Biomedical Informatics Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to join our team in developing rigorous, high-quality evaluation questions designed to assess and challenge advanced AI models. The primary objective is to create benchmark questions that test the boundaries of AI capabilities across diverse bioinformatics domains.

This role requires deep technical expertise combined with the ability to craft precise, unambiguous questions with well-defined evaluations. The ideal candidate will possess not only strong theoretical knowledge but also practical experience in designing assessment materials that have deterministic, verifiable outcomes.


Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop challenging bioinformatics coding questions that push the limits of AI model capabilities.
  • Create automated, coding-based evaluations with unit tests that objectively verify correctness.
  • Build comprehensive evaluation rubrics with 7–10 distinct criteria for each bioinformatics question.
  • Ensure every question is self-contained, well-defined, and completely unambiguous, including all domain rules and edge cases.
  • Develop problems where there is exactly one correct answer or outcome that can be deterministically validated.
  • Translate theoretical bioinformatics concepts into concrete, measurable outputs.
  • Enforce performance requirements with explicit constraints and tests to prevent inefficient or brute-force solutions.


Required Qualifications:

Educational Background

  • Master's degree of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • Ongoing PhD with 3+ years of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • PhD (completed) in Biomedical Informatics, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology or a closely related field (preferred).


Technical and other skills

  • Strong proficiency in biomedical data processing, analysis, and interpretation , including working with large‑scale datasets.
  • Experience with bioinformatics tools and pipelines (e.g., NGS workflows, multi‑omics, etc.).
  • Solid programming skills in Python / R
  • Experience working in Linux/Unix , Docker and version control.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills for working in interdisciplinary research teams


Domain Expertise Requirements

Candidates must demonstrate deep, expert-level knowledge in at least TWO (2) of the following five core bioinformatics domains:

1. Biomedical Image Processing

  • Processing of Radiology imaging: CT, MRI, PET/SPECT, Ultrasound imaging
  • Automating cell counting, identifying cell types, and analyzing tissue structures in pathology slides
  • Computational segmentation and boundary inference
  • Medical image formation, reconstruction & enhancement
  • Noise modeling and statistical denoising
  • Image sampling theory and resolution limits
  • Intensity standardization and harmonization
  • Geometric transformations and spatial calibration
  • Multi-modal image registration and alignment
  • Morphological and topological shape analysis
  • Quantitative imaging feature extraction
  • Fusing data from different modalities (MRI, PET, Genomics) for a comprehensive view to tailor treatments
  • pattern recognition and predictive modeling

2. Biomedical Signal Processing

  • Cardiovascular/hemodynamic signals (ECG, PPG, BP, HRV, etc)
  • Neural/brain electrical signals (EEG, EP/ERP; seizure/cognitive analysis)
  • Neuromuscular/motor signals (EMG, motor unit decomposition; prosthetics/rehab)
  • Ocular/visual system signals (EOG, blink/saccade analysis)
  • Respiratory signals (airflow, effort; sleep/disordered breathing)
  • Nonlinear, Statistical, and Adaptive Signal Analysis
  • Multichannel, Spatial, and Connectivity Signal Analysis
  • Machine Learning and Data‑Driven Biomedical Signal Analysis
  • Clinical Monitoring, Wearable, and Translational Signal Processing

3. Molecular & Omics based Personalized Medicine

  • Omics based risk / disease prediction (GWAS, PRS, bulk, single‑cell RNA‑seq, proteins / metabolite signatures associated with diseases)
  • Risk Prediction and Prognosis Modeling
  • Molecular patient subtyping
  • Liquid Biopsy and Circulating Biomarkers (ctDNA, cfRNA/miRNA, MRD, etc.)
  • Causal Inference & Mechanistic Inference (ATE/CATE, Trial emulation and counterfactual modeling)
  • Cross‑modal data fusion (omics + EHR + imaging / signals)
  • Longitudinal Patient Modeling and Disease Progression
  • Patient Stratification and Subtyping (molecular subtypes, endotypes)
  • Electronic Health Records and Clinical Data Science

4. Drug Discovery & Repurposing

  • Treatment response prediction
  • Structure-based drug design (Molecular docking, binding site analysis, Virtual screening workflow)
  • Protein structure analysis (PDB/mmCIF handling)
  • Chemoinformatics ( Ligand-based screening, molecular fingerprinting, 2D/3D data handling and chemical space analysis)
  • QSAR & ADMET Modeling
  • Drug–target interaction prediction
  • Drug sensitivity prediction in disease models
  • Repurposing via omics/network associations
  • Predictive Modeling for Drug Discovery Molecular Dynamics Simulation of Biomolecules (QM, DFT, stability, reactivity, PCA analysis )

5. Software / Utilities

  • Tool installation & environment management (docker/conda/pip)
  • Format conversion/validation (FASTA/FASTQ, BAM/VCF, PDB)
  • GUI-driven analysis workflows (step-by-step runs)
  • Workflow automation (scripts wrapping GUI tools)
  • Visualization tools (genome browsers, 3D viewers)
  • Container/VM execution and troubleshooting
  • Batch processing and report generation
  • Pipeline interoperability checks
  • Reproducibility packaging (configs, manifests)
  • Debugging typical bioinformatics tool errors

6. Regulatory Science and Clinical Policies

  • FDA/EMA regulatory pathways
  • Clinical Practice Guidelines & Standards of Care (e.g., NCCN, AHA, etc.)
  • Diagnostic Biomarker & Therapeutic Use Constraints
  • Medical Scenario Reasoning (case vignettes, Differential diagnosis)
  • Data & Content Compliance
  • Ethical Use, Safety, and Harm Prevention
  • Model Use Governance & Auditability
  • Policy‑Aligned Language & Communication
  • Clinical validation and cohort generalization
  • Privacy‑preserving learning


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : At least 30 hours per week. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 2 months; (expected start date is next week)


Evaluation Process:

  • Take home Assessment on Biomedical Informatics (2-6 hours)
  • Delivery discussion(15-30mins)


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

Com 12 anos de atuação no mercado, a DataEX é uma consultoria especializada em Dados e IA , com parcerias estratégicas com Microsoft, AWS e Databricks , atuando em projetos de alto impacto para grandes clientes. title: AI Data Annotation Specialist
description:
Job Role : AI Data Annotation Specialist

Location: Brazil

Work Type: Freelance / Project-based


About the Role

We are looking for Freelance Data Annotation Specialists with strong English proficiency to support global AI and Large Language Model (LLM) projects. This is a project-based freelancing opportunity, ideal for individuals seeking flexible work while contributing to cutting-edge AI development.


Key Responsibilities

  • Annotate and review text-based data following detailed project guidelines
  • Perform language-centric tasks such as classification, evaluation, and reasoning
  • Maintain high accuracy, consistency, and quality standards
  • Meet defined productivity benchmarks within project timelines
  • Flag unclear or ambiguous data as per escalation guidelines
  • Ensure confidentiality and compliance with data security requirements


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Excellent English and Portuguese proficiency (written and spoken)
  • Strong attention to detail and analytical skills
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote/project-based setup
  • Basic computer literacy and familiarity with online tools
  • Prior experience in data annotation, content review, or similar roles is a plus


Selection Process

Candidates must successfully clear the following assessments:

  • LLM Assessment
  • Versant English Assessment

Only candidates who pass both assessments will be eligible for Background Verification (BGV)


Additional Information

  • This is a freelancing role and does not include full-time employment benefits
  • Background verification is mandatory prior to onboarding

title: Legal Architect (Remote)
description:
About Lovie

Lovie is an AI-powered platform that helps anyone, anywhere launch a US company.

We build for solopreneurs, creators, and vibe coders — people who move fast, think independently, and use AI as a creative partner.

We’re a small, remote-first team building calm, powerful infrastructure for the next generation of internet builders.

What This Role Is

You are the legal architect of our company formation engine.

Your job is to turn complex US legal requirements into clean, automated, AI-native systems that feel simple and frictionless to founders.

You will own the accuracy, structure, and scalability of our formation service.

What You Absolutely NeedDeep, Hands-On US Formation Experience

You must have real operational experience with:

  • LLC vs C-Corp structures (pros, cons, founder fit)
  • Delaware and Wyoming state filing processes
  • EIN applications and IRS processes
  • BOI reporting requirements
  • Registered Agent requirements
  • Operating Agreements, Bylaws, and core post-formation compliance

You’ve filed, managed, and maintained entities yourself. This cannot be theoretical knowledge.

Systems & Automation Mindset

You:

  • Break complex legal processes into clean, logical workflows
  • Think in systems, not tasks
  • Document clearly and structure information well
  • Obsess over eliminating friction

If something is repetitive, your instinct is to automate it.

Strong Vibe Coding Energy (Non-Negotiable)

You don’t need to be a software engineer — but you think like one.

You:

  • Use AI tools daily
  • Prototype solutions before escalating
  • Enjoy no-code / low-code tools
  • Treat AI as a collaborator, not a novelty
  • Care about flow, elegance, and simplicity

You believe great infrastructure should feel invisible.

Clear Communication

You can:

  • Explain complex legal topics in plain English
  • Write structured documentation
  • Operate effectively in async, remote environments
Lovie Culture

We are:

Life-First.

We optimize for energy, not hours. Autonomy is default.

Calm Builders.

We reject hustle culture. We move deliberately and ship thoughtfully.

Low Ego, High Ownership.

No politics. No posturing. Just strong operators building clean systems.

AI-Native.

We don’t bolt AI on top. We build with it from the beginning.

Vibe Coder Friendly.

  • We value intuition, speed, experimentation, and creative problem-solving.

title: Senior Property Manager
description:
Join a team that values you. At StaffRight, we connect talented professionals with global opportunities—and we’re growing fast! With competitive pay, health insurance, paid time off (including national holidays), and a supportive HR team always in your corner, you’ll love building your career with us.


We’re looking for an experienced Senior Property Manager to oversee operations, lead a team of junior property managers, and ensure smooth day-to-day management of residential and/or commercial properties. The ideal candidate brings deep knowledge of U.S. property management, proven leadership skills, and the ability to balance tenant relations, administrative efficiency, and team management in a fast-paced environment.


This role is open to all candidates in the Philippines and all over Latin America.


What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Lead, mentor, and provide guidance to junior on-site property managers, ensuring best practices are followed across the team
  • Oversee tenant communications, lease renewals, and resolution of escalated tenant issues
  • Assist in managing leasing activities, including advertising, coordinating with your on-site team for property showings, applicant screening, and drafting lease agreements
  • Ensure compliance with lease terms, investigate violations, and address tenant disputes professionally
  • Supervise vendor coordination for maintenance repairs and upgrades, and coordinate with the on-site property manager for larger renovation projects
  • Collaborate with leadership on property marketing strategies and operational improvements
  • Oversee properties’ financial performance, including drafting budgets, tracking actuals to budget, and dictating strategies to maximize financial outcomes


What We’re Looking For:

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Strong background in U.S. residential and/or commercial property management (required)
  • Previous experience managing or leading a property management team
  • Proficiency with AppFolio or similar property management software
  • Available to work in US time zones (Graveyard shift in the Philippines)
  • Available to start within 2 weeks from job offer


Technical Requirements:

  • Comfortable in using time-trackers (e.g. Time Doctor)
  • Own laptop/desktop, noise-cancelling headphones, and webcam
  • Reliable internet connection (at least 50 Mbps)
  • Available backup equipment in cases of power and internet outages
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and Google Workspace
  • Proficiency with AppFolio or similar property management software



Why You’ll Love Working Here:


Competitive Compensation

We offer a competitive monthly salary of USD 1,500 - 2,500, based on your experience and qualifications. This is a full-time role requiring a 40-hour work week, and we make sure your expertise is valued and your contributions are fairly rewarded.


✈️ Paid Time Off and Sick Leave:

We believe in work-life balance. Enjoy generous paid time off and sick leave policies, allowing you to recharge, travel, or rest when needed—all while knowing your role is secure.

title: Senior AI/ML Developer
description:
About The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior AI/ML Developer to lead the technical development of an Industrial RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) solution for a major US-based client. The project addresses a critical challenge: transitioning 25 years of historical lab reports from SharePoint into an intelligent, GenAI-powered knowledge retrieval system.

You will be responsible for building a two-phase solution, starting with a Proof of Concept (POC) for a Pricing Analyst Agent and evolving into a Production-Ready Conversational AI Agent. This role focuses on automating knowledge retrieval, preserving institutional expertise, and enhancing the accuracy of fluid design processes through scalable AWS architectures.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and validate robust AI architectures leveraging AWS Infrastructure, specifically Amazon Bedrock and SageMaker.
  • Create GenAI pipelines and multi-agent workflows using AWS Step Functions, Lambda, and EventBridge.
  • Design platforms for processing massive volumes of unstructured data (text, image, audio, and video) integrated with RAG patterns.
  • Build interactive front-ends and AI dashboards using Streamlit for demos and operational workflows.
  • Implement best practices for AI governance, security, and observability using AWS IAM and CloudWatch.
  • Fine-tune pricing normalization and data retrieval to reduce bid risk and improve decision accuracy.


Required Qualifications

  • Good English communication skills (mandatory for direct collaboration with US stakeholders).
  • Proven hands-on experience building real-world GenAI applications using commercial LLMs.
  • Deep technical knowledge of the AWS ecosystem, including Serverless architectures and AI-specific services.
  • Strong experience building intelligent pipelines and event-oriented architectures.
  • Ability to design, test, and evaluate prompt engineering strategies and agentic frameworks.
  • Experience handling complex, unstructured data sources at scale.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with industrial-scale data migrations (SharePoint to Cloud).
  • Background in data science, specifically related to pricing normalization or cost baselines.
  • AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty or AWS Certified AI Practitioner certifications.

  • Strong experience building intelligent pipelines and event-oriented architectures.
  • Ability to design, test, and evaluate prompt engineering strategies and agentic frameworks.
  • Experience handling complex, unstructured data sources at scale.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with industrial-scale data migrations (SharePoint to Cloud).
  • Background in data science, specifically related to pricing normalization or cost baselines.
  • AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty or AWS Certified AI Practitioner certifications.

title: Senior AI/ML Developer
description:
About The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior AI/ML Developer to lead the technical development of an Industrial RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) solution for a major US-based client. The project addresses a critical challenge: transitioning 25 years of historical lab reports from SharePoint into an intelligent, GenAI-powered knowledge retrieval system.

You will be responsible for building a two-phase solution, starting with a Proof of Concept (POC) for a Pricing Analyst Agent and evolving into a Production-Ready Conversational AI Agent. This role focuses on automating knowledge retrieval, preserving institutional expertise, and enhancing the accuracy of fluid design processes through scalable AWS architectures.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and validate robust AI architectures leveraging AWS Infrastructure, specifically Amazon Bedrock and SageMaker.
  • Create GenAI pipelines and multi-agent workflows using AWS Step Functions, Lambda, and EventBridge.
  • Design platforms for processing massive volumes of unstructured data (text, image, audio, and video) integrated with RAG patterns.
  • Build interactive front-ends and AI dashboards using Streamlit for demos and operational workflows.
  • Implement best practices for AI governance, security, and observability using AWS IAM and CloudWatch.
  • Fine-tune pricing normalization and data retrieval to reduce bid risk and improve decision accuracy.


Required Qualifications

  • Good English communication skills (mandatory for direct collaboration with US stakeholders).
  • Proven hands-on experience building real-world GenAI applications using commercial LLMs.
  • Deep technical knowledge of the AWS ecosystem, including Serverless architectures and AI-specific services.
  • Strong experience building intelligent pipelines and event-oriented architectures.
  • Ability to design, test, and evaluate prompt engineering strategies and agentic frameworks.
  • Experience handling complex, unstructured data sources at scale.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with industrial-scale data migrations (SharePoint to Cloud).
  • Background in data science, specifically related to pricing normalization or cost baselines.
  • AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty or AWS Certified AI Practitioner certifications.

title: Ingeniero de soporte
description:
SaaS Support Engineer


Overview and Purpose


As a SaaS Support Engineer, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the smooth operation of Markmonitor Group’s growing number of cloud-based services but with specific emphasis on our Microsoft suite of SaaS services. Your focus will be on providing exceptional technical support to end-users, managing SaaS platforms, and managing/enhancing security controls within the scope of the company's ISMS.



SaaS Support

· Manage and administer Markmonitor Group’s SaaS applications with emphasis on our Microsoft 365 and Azure Active Directory implementation and user base.

· Ensure that Microsoft 365 product knowledge is shared with team members on a regular basis and that collectively we build our team knowledge of the 365 ecosystem.

· Stay informed of and promote through prototyping/POCs, new products and features to help with business workflow efficiency, compliance and with opportunities to reduce cost.

· Collaborate with cross-functional teams to collect requirements, design, configure, deploy and manage SaaS applications.

· Administer and maintain SaaS platforms, ensuring optimal performance and availability.

· Monitor service health, troubleshoot incidents, and escalate complex issues as needed.


Technical Support

· Provide first line IT technical support to company staff through in person and remote means keeping staff Informed of progress.

· Troubleshoot and resolve user issues related to software functionality, access, and performance.

· Ensure monitoring, prioritizing and triaging of support tickets and promptly establish resolution ownership. Wherever possible owning and resolving tickets within the 1st line team or escalating them where necessary to the appropriate 2nd line support team.

· Working closely with all technology functional teams to onboard systems knowledge and skills needed to resolve more tickets at the front line.

· Purchasing, configuring and managing the company's Windows and Apple based PCs, laptops and printers/peripherals and ensuring the asset register Is maintained.

· Administering the company's VOIP telephone system (BT Cloud).


InfoSec Support

· Implement security best practices across company SaaS services and ensure Inventory of SaaS services Is maintained.

· Working with the IT Operations team to maintain the company's Microsoft Secure Score at 70%+ through effective monitoring and use of adopted security applications and services which Include

o Microsoft Defender for Endpoint

o Microsoft InTune

· Further improve Security Posture through controlled and tested implementation of Secure Score recommendations as they relate to Identity management, data, devices and app management.

· Ensuring full compliance with Markmonitor Group’s ISMS (certified to ISO27701) in general and specifically as It relates to IT technical support services.

· Collaborate with Markmonitor Group’s SOC In the analysis and resolution of security related incidents. These will largely be tracked In our SIEM platform, Microsoft Sentinel.



Other relevant support Activities

· Provide support to the marketing department with respect to the ongoing maintenance of company (wordpress) websites.

· Provide the IT Operations team with project office support to help the team's engineers focus on delivery rather than management.

· Keep the management updated with regular progress/Issues/risks for both project specific or BAU conducted by the technical support team.



Qualifications and Skills

· 2 Years + experience in a relevant role.

· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field however work experience Is more Important.

· Demonstrable use of administering the Microsoft 365 suite of services used by the company (see skills matrix)

· Proportional understanding of cybersecurity principles and best practices, including threat detection, incident response, and compliance. Is not expected to be an authority but can demonstrate good industry and technology awareness. Proactively contributing to ongoing improvement in the company’s security posture.

· Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

· Excellent communication and customer service skills.

· You should demonstrate appropriate skills and knowledge in the use of the following technologies and frameworks.

title: Application Developer - PL
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


As pessoas são e continuarão sendo uma parte importante dessa missão. Em tudo o que fazemos, nossos funcionários desempenham um papel decisivo para nossos clientes e uns para os outros. É por isso que estamos sempre em busca de profissionais experientes e em início de carreira para se juntarem à nossa equipe.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Procuramos profissionais que também queiram impactar o mundo positivamente! Você é um deles? Se sim, cadastre-se na vaga abaixo!


Responsabilidades:


  • Desenvolver, implementar e manter aplicativos web e sistemas de software de acordo com as necessidades do negócio;
  • Analisar requisitos, projetar soluções, escrever código, realizar testes e fazer a implantação de novos recursos e funcionalidades;
  • Colaborar com a equipe de desenvolvimento para resolver problemas, melhorar a qualidade do código e a eficiência dos processos;
  • Participar de reuniões e workshops para entender as demandas dos clientes e stakeholders.
  • Documentar o desenvolvimento e as atualizações realizadas nos sistemas;
  • Suportar e resolver incidentes relacionados aos aplicativos em produção.


Requisitos:


  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos como desenvolvedor de aplicativos web;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em linguagens de programação como Java, JavaScript, entre outras;
  • Familiaridade com frameworks e bibliotecas como Spring, Angular, etc;
  • Habilidades em desenvolvimento back-end e front-end;
  • Experiência em bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis, como Scrum;
  • Boa comunicação, capacidade de trabalho em equipe e habilidades de resolução de problemas.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência em arquitetura de microsserviços;
  • Conhecimento em DevOps e ferramentas de CI/CD.



Liberte todo o seu potencial e engenhosidade – molde o seu próprio futuro. Somos mais do que apenas um local de trabalho; somos uma incubadora de talentos. Com diversos caminhos e oportunidades de aprendizado e carreira de longo prazo, oferecemos inúmeras maneiras de realizar seus sonhos.


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.
